sources.note: No prosodic statement; historical-phonology cognate tables only. Source list names Galis 1956, Voorhoeve 1971/1975, Anceaux (Smits & Voorhoeve 1994, after Mallo), Menanti 2005 (245 terms, Tefalma = Tofanma I village) and Wambaliau 2005:24-27. The Menanti/Wambaliau transcriptions carry sporadic IPA stress marks (e.g. Tofanma 'urine' [ˈtʊ], 'child' [ˈmlɛ ~ məlɛ]) but most items are unmarked, so no placement rule can be read off.
